guide.intro: Essential apps and university links organized by purpose for dorm life.
guide.emptyDescription: If you couldn't find it here, try asking Torch AI directly.

laundry-metaclub.title: Washer & Dryer (MetaClub)
laundry-metaclub.description: Check washer/dryer availability and pay for Dorm 1 & 2.

laundry-dorm3.title: Dorm 3 Laundry Room
laundry-dorm3.description: No app required—pay by cash or prepaid card. Tap for details.

infoModal.title: Dorm 3 Laundry Guide
infoModal.subtitle: No app supported · On-site payment
points: Dorm 3 laundry machines do not support apps like MetaClub.
You can pay with cash or a rechargeable card at the kiosk in the laundry room.
For malfunctions or issues, submit a repair request via Edumac or contact Dorm 3 Office (032-858-7222).

facility-dorm1.title: Facility Repair Request
facility-dorm1.description: Report Dorm 1 facility issues on the INU Portal system.

facility-dorm23.title: Facility Repair Request
facility-dorm23.description: Report Dorm 2 & 3 (BTL) repairs on the Edumac facility system.

unidorm-complain.title: Other Dorm Reports
unidorm-complain.description: Submit non-facility complaints and track progress on UNIDorm.

intip-menu.title: Dorm & Campus Dining
intip-menu.description: Check Dorm 1 cafeteria and campus meal menus on INTIP.

portal-apply.title: Current Student Application
portal-apply.description: Apply for dorm residence, regular or mid-term move-out via INU Portal.

erp-freshman-apply.title: Freshman / Transfer Application
erp-freshman-apply.description: Dorm application page for new/transfer students without a portal ID.

dorm-lecture.title: Dormitory Liberal Arts Lectures
dorm-lecture.description: View schedules and apply for free resident lectures.

dorm-rules.title: Dormitory Rules
dorm-rules.description: Curfew hours (05:00–02:00), overnight stay, parcel & shared facility rules.

dorm-facilities.title: Amenities by Dormitory
dorm-facilities.description: Check floor locations of convenience stores, parcel rooms, gym & kitchenettes.

dorm-archive.title: Points Table & Archive
dorm-archive.description: Latest reward/penalty point criteria and resident guide documents.

dorm-home.title: INU Dormitory Website
dorm-home.description: Go to the official INU Dormitory website.

chatbuli.title: Ask Torch AI
chatbuli.description: Ask our AI chatbot about curfew, points, move-in/out, and more.

dorm-qna.title: Dormitory Q&A Board
dorm-qna.description: Official 1:1 inquiry board for the Dormitory Office.
